The total number of balls is T=r+b+g, and each draw is uniform over the current urn. Thus the conditional draw probabilities are P(R|r,b,g)=r/T, P(B|r,b,g)=b/T, and P(G|r,b,g)=g/T. These rules plus S0 define all one-step transitions.
